findings.summary: SSR fallback dialog has a visible title in content but no accessible-name association.
findings.consequence: For a directly requested contents dialog before hydration, the server-rendered role="dialog"/aria-modal="true" element may not expose "Innehållsförteckning" as the dialog's accessible name even though the heading is present in the body.
findings.evidence: The fallback root is rendered as a plain div with role and aria-modal while headlessReady is false, and the title component falls back to an h2 on line 83 without a stable id connected by aria-labelledby on the dialog root. SSR tests assert the h2 exists inside the dialog but do not assert the dialog's accessible name.
findings.recommendation: Give the fallback title a stable id and set aria-labelledby on the fallback dialog root, or use an equivalent Headless UI-compatible binding that preserves the SSR accessible name until Dialog/ DialogTitle take over after mount.
